title: Risk-adjusted synergy phasing and returns
prompt:
Evaluate Pioneer synergies and five-year equity returns under the IC-approved base case.

Begin with the July corporate-development investment-committee thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's banker-case warning. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Probability-weight supported cost synergies and dis-synergies before annual phasing, exclude cross-sell from the base, apply tax to EBITDA benefits, and deduct the full one-time implementation cash costs from Year 1 cash flow while also reporting them separately. Add recurring year-five synergy value to standalone exit equity value and calculate equity NPV and IRR.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also build an independent downside return case with item haircuts, timing delay, added costs, lower exit multiple, IRR, NPV, and payback.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `year_1_risk_adjusted_after_tax_synergy_cash_flow`, `year_2_risk_adjusted_after_tax_synergy_cash_flow`, `year_3_risk_adjusted_after_tax_synergy_cash_flow`, `one_time_cash_costs`, `risk_adjusted_exit_equity_value`, `five_year_equity_irr`, `equity_npv`, `irr_hurdle_met`, `revenue_synergy_included`, `downside_year_1_synergy_cash_flow`, `downside_year_3_synergy_cash_flow`, `downside_exit_equity_value`, `downside_five_year_equity_irr`, `downside_equity_npv`, `downside_payback_year`, `downside_irr_hurdle_met`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
